text.title: ui-ux-design.md Template Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps: decide whether the artefact is required, then fill the six sections in fixed order from the template and close on readiness.md item 7.

step.name: decide-applicability
step.input: The feature's diff and the surfaces it touches.
step.action: Check the REQUIRED cases — web UI (page, component, form, button, modal, navigation), mobile UI (screen, sheet, gesture handler), CLI TUI (interactive prompt, picker, dashboard view) — against the SKIPPED cases: backend-only (services, queues, jobs), API-only (REST / GraphQL contracts with no client change), data migrations (pure DB schema work), internal refactor (input and output unchanged), build-system / CI / infra (no rendered surface).
step.output: required | skipped, with the surface named.
step.decision-gate: Skipped — mark readiness.md item 7 "no UI impact" with a one-line reason and stop; do not file the artefact "just in case".

step.name: instantiate-template
step.action: Copy the fillable template into `features/in-progress/F0NN-slug/ui-ux-design.md`. It carries the six sections in order and the audit-row stubs.
step.output: ui-ux-design.md skeleton in the feature directory.

step.name: intent-and-layout
step.action: Intent — what the user is trying to accomplish, in one sentence. Layout — coarse description of element placement; a screenshot or wireframe is allowed but not required.

step.name: states-table
step.action: Fill the States table with one row per state: empty, loading, error, success, disabled. Each row describes the visible affordance. Name each state before code lands.
step.decision-gate: Only "success" filled in — the other four will be improvised in code; do not proceed.

step.name: nielsen-audit
step.input: The five heuristics N1, N3, N4, N5, N6 (see 05-examples.xml for the one-line test of each).
step.action: Fill five rows, one per heuristic. Each row: heuristic, finding, fix-or-noted-OK. Do not add rows for N2/N7/N8/N9/N10.

step.name: norman-audit
step.input: Every clickable / tappable / focusable element; every user action.
step.action: Two rows: affordance — every interactive element visually signals it is interactive and hover is applied only to clickable elements; feedback — every user action produces visible acknowledgement within 100ms (loading indicator, button press state, or focus change).

step.name: copy-and-microcopy
step.input: Button labels, error messages, empty-state text, success messages.
step.action: Write the exact strings, not placeholders.

step.name: shape-check-and-close
step.action: Confirm the six sections appear in order and none is omitted — empty sections carry "n/a" and a reason. Validate against 02-output-contract.xml. Then the reviewer ticks readiness.md item 7 with the file as evidence.
step.output: ui-ux-design.md passing the contract; readiness.md item 7 ticked.
step.decision-gate: Any forbidden pattern from 02-output-contract.xml still matching — fix before item 7 is ticked.

list.item: ui-ux-design.md validates against the schema in 02-output-contract.xml
Nielsen audit has exactly five rows; States table has all five states
No failure mode from 03-failure-modes.xml is present
